shortBio.en: Van Halen frontman 1974–85 (and later returns); carnival bark opposite Eddie’s precision.
shortBio.zh: Van Halen 主唱 1974–85（及后来回归）；对位 Eddie 精度的嘉年华吠叫。

whyHub.en: Singer-era pole in the Roth vs Hagar forever fight.
whyHub.zh: Roth vs Hagar 永久内战里的主唱极。

body.en: Showman vocal and talk-sing. Leaves mid-80s; solo career; returns for later tours. Person page keeps Roth-era catalog distinct from Hagar radio years.
body.zh: 表演人声与说唱式唱法。80 年代中期离开；独唱；后期巡演回归。人物页把 Roth 时期目录与 Hagar 电台年分开。
